## Minecraft 26.1.2 / 26.2 compatibility
Fixes the Minecraft 26.2 startup crash in SidebarMixin by removing the version-fragile Gui.getFont shadow and using the client font directly. The mod metadata supports Minecraft **26.1.2 through 26.2.x**. The selected release JAR is the exact artifact from the successful CI build on commit 4ad7a3fa5d69d9674ba9cfd311817d7601c92e9c. The automated build and rendering/integration test suite passed.

## Verification
All unit and integration checks in the selected build passed, including the actual Fabric client rendering smoke test and CustomScoreboard, SkyHanni, and combined integration tests. The selected artifact is the exact tested JAR, not a rebuild. Test fixtures are excluded from the published JAR. The CI client build targets Minecraft 26.1.2; the 26.2-specific fix addresses the crash signature reported on 26.2, but CI does not run a separate authenticated 26.2 client.

## Installation
Replace the old JAR with **coins-to-money-1.2.4.jar**. The mod's internal version remains **1.2.4**; this GitHub release is **1.2.5**. Keep only one version installed. Existing settings are retained. CustomScoreboard, SkyHanni and Kotlin remain optional and are not bundled.

Requires **Minecraft 26.1.2 through 26.2.x**, **Java 25**, **Fabric Loader 0.19.5+**, and **Fabric API 0.155.3+26.1.2**. Mod Menu is optional. **K** opens settings; **O** toggles conversion.
